title: Release Management
meta: A repeatable release process with checklists, versioning and user-facing release notes. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Release management with clear notes for your users
overview: We set up a calm, repeatable way to ship. That includes a release checklist, version numbering, a changelog, staging sign-off and a rollback plan, plus plain-language release notes for your users. We then run your next release with you, so the process is proven rather than only written down. Your team ends up with a routine that works without us.

pkgs.blurb: A release checklist and versioning scheme for your team.
A first release run through the new process, with user notes.
Release process with automation, user updates and training.

faq: Do we need an automated pipeline first?
No. A checklist works on manual releases too. If you want automation, the Premium package adds changelog automation, and our cloud hosting page covers full deployment pipelines.

As often as your team can test comfortably. Small, frequent releases are safer than big rare ones. We suggest a rhythm based on your team size and test habits, and write it into the calendar template.
Can you announce updates to users?
We write the release notes and can draft an in-app message or email. You approve the wording and send it from your own tools.
We can prepare store release notes and checklists for Apple and Google. Approval is up to the stores, so we plan for review time and never promise a release date they control.
